sources.text:
In my last year of university (Ankara, graduation June 2026) we are doing a project for the computer science department. The problem was the department have many old servers and every lecturer is installing the softwares by hand, so every server is different and when one is broken nobody know how to fix.

We are a group of four students. We make an automation with Ansible for install all the servers in same way, and we put a Gitea for keeping the playbooks and one Grafana to see the servers. We choose Ansible and not Puppet because Ansible is not needing an agent on the old servers and the department is not allowing to install new agents. This was important decision.

A big problem: after we run the playbooks the HTTPS of the department website is stop working. Two days we are searching. In the end the problem was the playbook is changing the certificate folder permissions to 600 for the security and the web server user cannot read the files anymore. We fix it with giving the group read permission only for the web server group. I learn that the security change can break the things which are working, and always you must test in a copy first.

Now 11 servers are managed by the playbooks and the new server setup is taking 15 minutes, before was one day.

I want to apply to Graphcore because I like very much the infrastructure part and the operating systems, more than the writing of applications, and Graphcore is making the platform for the running of the models.
I wrote the Ansible playbooks for the server setup and I found the certificate permission problem by checking the web server logs.

documents.text:
For my final-year project in Ankara, four of us automated the setup of the computer science department's old servers with Ansible so that every server was installed the same way. The department had many old servers, and each one had been installed manually and was different from the others, so when one server was broken nobody knew how to fix it. Now 11 servers are managed by the playbooks, and a new server setup takes 15 minutes, whereas before it took one day.

We chose Ansible rather than Puppet because Ansible does not need an agent on the old servers, and the department would not allow installing new agents.

After we ran the playbooks, HTTPS on the department website stopped working, and we spent two days searching for the cause. My friend Emre found the certificate permission problem from the web server logs, and I tested the permission fix. The playbook had changed the certificate folder permissions to 600 for security, so the web server user could not read the files. We fixed it by giving group read permission only to the web server group. I learned that a security change can break things that are already working, and that it is important to always test in a copy first.

We were a group of four students. I wrote the Ansible playbooks for the server setup.

Dear Graphcore hiring team,

I am applying for the Graduate Cloud Platform Engineer 2027 role at Graphcore.

I like infrastructure and operating systems more than writing applications, and Graphcore makes the platform for running models.

I am in my last year of university in Ankara and am graduating in June 2026, and we are doing a project for the computer science department. The department had many old servers, each manually installed and different, and nobody knew how to fix a broken one. We made Ansible automation to install all servers the same way, with Gitea for playbooks and Grafana to see servers. I wrote the Ansible playbooks for the server setup. We chose Ansible and not Puppet because Ansible needs no agent and the department would not allow installing new agents.

After we ran the playbooks, the department website HTTPS stopped working and we searched for two days. My friend Emre found the certificate permission problem from the web server logs, and I tested the permission fix. The playbook changed certificate folder permissions to 600 for security, so the web server user could not read the files. We fixed it by giving group read permission only to the web server group. Now 11 servers are managed by the playbooks, and a new server setup takes 15 minutes, before one day.

Thank you for considering my application.

Kind regards, Ellie
